key_purpose: Deterministic test-only reference key for ccs-verifier canonical vectors and upstream build identification. This seed is PUBLIC and MUST NOT be used as a deployment trust root. Deployments MUST generate and pin their own Ed25519 key; do not trust receipts signed by this key outside the bundled test vectors.
seed_derivation: SHA-256(b'ccs-verifier/reference-issuer/v1') — fully reproducible from source, no secret entropy.
trust_model: VERIFIED (signature valid) vs ACCEPTED (issuer identity trusted via pin/registry). Embedded-key self-verification yields VERIFIED. A relying party MUST additionally pin the public_key or public_key_fingerprint to a known issuer before treating a receipt as ACCEPTED.
